Bertil Braun

Featured research system · Distributed self-play RL

AlphaZero-Style Chess & Go Engine

An end-to-end AlphaZero-style research platform that trains and serves neural chess and Go agents entirely from self-play. Performance-critical C++ implements the games, encoding, batched CUDA inference, and MCTS; Python orchestrates replay, multi-GPU DDP training, automated evaluation, and live deployment. The run below reached superhuman strength under the project’s Stockfish 13 calibration within a deliberately constrained compute envelope.

LLM infrastructure · Technical report

LLM-Light — Artifact-Addressed Execution

LLM-Light resolves complete experiment configurations into artifact-addressed stages, preserving a self-contained experiment interface while sharing compatible work. Its single-node executor coordinates exclusive artifact production, concurrent GPU jobs, and relaunch recovery; focused tests validate identity propagation, GPU allocation, export, and supported checkpoint restoration.

LLM evaluation · GEM² 2025

Scalable Automated Evaluation with LLMs

A reference-free framework for ranking open-ended LLM outputs when no ground-truth answer exists. Multiple models judge every pair in both orders, and Elo aggregation produced rankings that agreed strongly with rankings from 20 domain experts.

GEM² 2025 paper Multi-model judging Bidirectional comparisons Pairwise Elo

Speech · Real-time systems · Technical report

Voice-Light — Full-Duplex Streaming Voice Agent

A deployed full-duplex voice agent that keeps listening while it speaks, handles interruptions and backchannels, and executes structured tools. The project spans synthetic and human data preparation, two trained adapters, locked evaluation, and a two-GPU streaming runtime; an eight-turn microphone run completed every turn with 783 ms median latency from the final voice-activity endpoint to browser-rendered audio.

Live demo Technical report Full-duplex streaming Causal turn-taking Synthetic training data

Computer vision · Technical report · Live demo

GybeLock — Windsurfing Video Intelligence

An offline computer-vision system that turns long-shot windsurfing footage into stable, rider-relative videos using conservative local tracklets, camera-compensated global association, and pose-guided framing. On a 21-video fixed-observation development benchmark, it reduced fragmentation excess from 845 to 42 relative to OC-SORT; the end-to-end system is available to try live.

Live demo Technical report YOLO detection Pose + multi-object tracking

Graph RL · Technical report

Graph-Based Traffic Signal Control

A graph-RL interface that scores individual traffic movements and deterministically assembles them into each junction's legal signal phases. One parameter set executed across five heterogeneous city networks and, within the matched grid family, outperformed max-pressure control on an unseen 6×6 network at every tested demand.

arXiv report Graph neural network Variable action spaces PPO · SUMO

LLM systems · Agents & orchestration

Agentic LLM Systems

Three separate agent-system projects: Temporal-Light, a self-hosted durable workflow engine; an evidence-gated coding runtime built on it; and an independent story narrator built from five A2A agents and four MCP tool servers. Together they demonstrate durable execution, tool-grounded software work, and multi-agent service boundaries.
